V2.3.0.description:
The back end overhaul is finally complete making logic be able to take any possible path to be able to craft an item!!!
And with it a name change to the ap world which I've been wanting to do for a while.
The new logic should also be several times more maintainable and stable which should allow for many more mods/modpacks to be comparable although the extractor does still need to be extended to ensure everything is truly possible (I may have gone slightly overboard to ensure the logic implementation is infinitely adaptable and I should need to do such a big overhaul again, good thing as well with the upcoming changes in 2.1)

Unfortunately this has come with the removal of all randomised recipes (like the rocket part recipe and science packs). I plan to add this back in some form but the code for it was from core factorio archipelago forced to work other data formats. This made it end up being quite messy so I plan to create it from scratch, would love if people provide suggestions and ideas on this

# Changelogs:
- Changed name from `Factorio Bob's` to `Factorio Modpacks`
- Addition of Any logic
- Removal of Best logic
- Facpacks no longer need baking
  - This means you no longer need to clone the repository to make a Facpack
- Removal of all randomised recipes along with options relating to them
- Moved to rule builder
- Fixed location of info save on Linux (hopefully)
